Bellaworks homepage · retro poster concept, round two
Conventional stacked layout (no bento tiles). Palette sampled from the reference: red #df0118, cream #efdec4, dark #2b0b0a.
Style devices carried over from the reference: condensed display caps + brush script, round stamp, starbursts, speech bubble, star + dashed dividers, icon strip, rubber-hose mascot (illustrated, no photography).
Copy is verbatim from the current homepage.
